description: UI design skill for Claude Code, Codex and other AI agents: explore distinct directions, compare them side by side, refine against real screenshots. 给 AI Agent 用的 UI 设计 Skill。

latest_release.name: v0.34.9
latest_release.body:
修复风格对比页静态图预览灰边、角标叠字与长标题截断问题。

### 更新内容
- **静态图比例自适应与去灰边**：`assets/style-explorer.html` 在渲染静态图片候选（`kind === 'image'`）时按真实 `naturalWidth`/`naturalHeight` 自适应画布尺寸并移除多余灰底留白；当全部候选均为静态图或固定画布时，自动隐藏不适用的桌面/手机视口切换控件。
- **静态标记与提示条防重叠**：调整 `.static` 与悬停/聚焦态 `.peek` 的显隐与叠层关系，避免悬停或键盘聚焦预览卡片时底部提示条与静态角标重叠。
- **长标题可读性优化**：卡片标题 `.cap .name` 改为最多两行换行展示，并为卡片标题与胶片条标题补充 `title` 悬停提示，避免长标题被单行硬截断。
- **测试与版本同步**：`tests/test_build_explorer.py` 补充单元测试与无头 Chrome 回归测试，同步版本号至 `0.34.9`。

English · [中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [한국어](https://ui.oiloil.org/ko/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-en&utm_content=lang-bar) · [Deutsch](https://ui.oiloil.org/de/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-en&utm_content=lang-bar) · [Español](https://ui.oiloil.org/es/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-en&utm_content=lang-bar) [![GitHub Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/oil-oil/oil-ui?style=flat-square&color=292e2b)](https://github.com/oil-oil/oil-ui/stargazers) [![skills.sh](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills.sh-4.6K%2B_installs-4a5d4e?style=flat-square)](https://www.skills.sh/oil-oil/oil-ui/oil-ui) [![Live Gallery](https://img.shields.io/badge/live_gallery-141_examples-3d5a45?style=flat-square)](https://ui.oiloil.org/en/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-en&utm_content=hero-gallery) [![Blind Benchmark](https://img.shields.io/badge/blind_test-87.0%2F100_(15_runs)-5b533b?style=flat-square)](https://ui.oiloil.org/en/guide/ui-design-skills-tested/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-en&utm_content=guide-benchmark) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-60675f?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) **Oil UI** is an interface & UI/UX design skill for AI coding agents. It recommends one clear visual direction and refines it against real-browser screenshots, or explores 3 genuinely distinct directions side by side when you ask to compare. Browse 141 live websites, apps, dashboards, and components at [ui.oiloil.org](https://ui.oiloil.org/en/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-en&utm_content=intro-text). ```bash npx skills add oil-oil/oil-ui ``` **Compatible with:** Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, Cline, Antigravity, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Roo Code, DeepSeek Harness ([dsh-oil-ui](https://github.com/oil-oil/dsh-oil-ui)), Kimi Code, Trae, and any `SKILL.md`-compatible agent.

### Art-Directed Landing Pages (Included Free with Oil UI Pro: `oil-art-landing`) Beyond dashboards and product UI, **Oil UI Pro** includes the companion skill **`oil-art-landing`** at no extra cost: a **rich library of desktop & mobile app visual anchors** (infrared film, polar glacier, X-ray darkroom, sunlit conservatory, wet forest moss, fluted glass, cotton letterpress, terracotta dunes, optical ice, indigo shibori, and more) plus an open derivation grammar—compare 3 directions first, adapt or derive to fit your product, and ship live animated pages with real foreground occlusion. [Explore 20 interactive live examples →](https://ui.oiloil.org/en/art-landing/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-en&utm_content=art-landing-banner)

## Installation Run in your terminal: ```bash npx skills add oil-oil/oil-ui ``` Or send this sentence to an agent that can install skills: ```text Install this skill for me: run npx skills add oil-oil/oil-ui ``` It works right after installation with zero configuration. When a newer version is available, your agent mentions it at the end of a reply; ask it to update whenever you want. If you already have Oil UI Pro installed, you don't need the open-source edition—installing both makes them compete for the same requests. If you use DeepSeek Harness, install the native plugin [dsh-oil-ui](https://github.com/oil-oil/dsh-oil-ui) (`dsh plugin --profile web add github:oil-oil/dsh-oil-ui`; it bundles the free edition and automatically detects a local Oil UI Pro installation). ## Usage Tell your agent what you want to build, review, or redesign: - “Use oil-ui to explore a few design directions for this course booking product and build pages I can preview.” - “Create three designs with different typography, colors, and compositions. Put them on a comparison page so I can choose.” - “Polish this page using the project’s existing design guidelines.” - “Review this homepage and explain what to change and how. Leave the files untouched.” - “Recreate this page from the screenshot and add a mobile layout too.” Share any brand assets, screenshots, or existing codebase you have. It can start without references and only asks questions when the deliverable itself is ambiguous. Intermediate candidates, screenshots, and media caches stay in `.oil-ui`; final code and production assets are written directly to your project. ## How it designs 1. **Understand what the product is.** Before drawing anything, it names the product category, finds two or three peers with distinctive styles, studies why their choices work, and decides what to keep or break away from. 2. **Turn “premium” and “clean” into real decisions.** It sets a concrete tone from the subject, audience, and brand voice—lively or calm, polished or raw, dense or airy—and turns it into visible choices for typefaces, whitespace, and color proportion. 3. **Start each direction from something concrete.** Ideas come from a material, a setting, an object, or the visual language of another craft—not vague adjectives like “minimal” or “bold.” 4. **Decide who the first screen is for.** On pages where people browse, shop, or get work done, screen one starts with the content and controls. Only pages meant to persuade get a choreographed opening layout, settled before copy is written. 5. **Make explicit comparisons truly different.** When you ask for 3 directions, layout, typography, color, and key imagery may share at most one trait between any two. It squints at light/dark shapes side by side and reworks the layout if two look alike. 6. **Leave one moment people remember.** Instead of decorating every block, it makes one or two interactions memorable—a tap response, a payment confirmation, AI in progress, or a 404 page—while keeping the rest quiet. 7. **You decide what looks right.** It recommends one direction for confirmation by default, or generates a single comparison page when asked so you can pick and steer before full implementation. 8. **Trust the real screen.** When a page is built, it opens desktop and mobile viewports to inspect real screenshots, dispatches an isolated reviewer without build-history bias, and finishes with a subtraction pass. For existing-codebase UI renovations, `DESIGN.md` consolidation, optional multi-round 9/10 deep polish, or 19 coded card prototypes, see [Oil UI Pro](https://ui.oiloil.org/en/pro/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-en&utm_content=inline-pro). Full differences are listed [below](#open-source-and-pro). ## Benchmarks & Playbooks - **[4 UI Design Skills Tested (15 Blind Runs & Live Demos)](https://ui.oiloil.org/en/guide/ui-design-skills-tested/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-en&utm_content=guide-benchmark)**: Same model, same task brief, 15 independent generations across Oil UI, `frontend-design`, `UI UX Pro Max`, `Impeccable`, and a no-Skill control, with desktop/mobile screenshots and live HTML demos. - **[Refreshing Existing Project UI Without Breaking Logic](https://ui.oiloil.org/en/guide/existing-project-ui-renovation/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-en&utm_content=guide-renovation)**: How to diagnose live screens, renovate across three controlled steps (tidy noise, upgrade layout, rework flow), cut clicks, and extract a repo-wide `DESIGN.md`. - **[Fixing Generic "AI Slop" UI](https://ui.oiloil.org/en/guide/fix-ai-ui-slop/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-en&utm_content=guide-antislop)**: A subtraction checklist for stripping out glowing eyebrow pills, 4px left accent bars, triple-nested cards, and invented KPI metrics. - **Agent & Scenario Guides**: [Claude Code UI Design](https://ui.oiloil.org/en/guide/claude-code-ui-design/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-en&utm_content=guide-claude) · [OpenAI Codex UI Design](https://ui.oiloil.org/en/guide/codex-ui-design/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-en&utm_content=guide-codex) · [SaaS Landing Pages](https://ui.oiloil.org/en/guide/landing-page-design/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-en&utm_content=guide-landing) · [Dashboards & Workspaces](https://ui.oiloil.org/en/guide/dashboard-workspace-design/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-en&utm_content=guide-dashboard) · [Interactive Walkthrough](https://ui.oiloil.org/en/intro/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-en&utm_content=intro) ## Built-in style comparison page

When you want to compare designs, it puts them side by side on one page. Candidates can be HTML files, images, or running local dev servers, with the current version placed first as a baseline. Switch between desktop and mobile viewports, open each candidate at actual size, browse with arrow keys, click “Select” on your favorite, and paste the copied prompt back into your agent. ## Open source and Pro

The open-source version takes a new page from a blank start to a distinctive design. Pro builds on that: it makes interfaces easier to use, renovates existing projects without breaking logic, and raises the bar with deeper review and polishing. | | Oil UI (open source) | Oil UI Pro | | --- | :---: | :---: | | Design direction: product category, tone, distinct directions, comparison page | ✓ | ✓ | | Visuals: hierarchy, typography, color, spacing, imagery, and motion | ✓ | ✓ | | Memorable moments and scroll storytelling (parallax, continuous shots) | ✓ | ✓ | | Screenshot recreation | ✓ | ✓ | | Pacing, feel, generated assets, and real-time 3D for mini-games | ✓ | ✓ | | Independent review | Visual scoring and a lightweight UX walkthrough | Default blind review + optional deep polish (up to 3 rounds aiming for 9/10 & same-path UX rechecks); direction-overlap checks and autonomous UX risk probes | | Polish: checks for AI design defaults, a detail checklist, and how to simplify | | ✓ | | Usability: interactions and states, forms, dialogs and popovers, desktop and mobile layouts | | ✓ | | Dashboards and tools: workspace layouts chosen for the product, with one style throughout | | ✓ | | Existing projects: separate approaches for a UI refresh, a flow fix, and a new feature | Tells you which one you need | ✓ | | Prototype to production code: a mapping table, built with the project's own components and libraries, checked side by side against the prototype | Doesn't paste the prototype's code wholesale | ✓ | | Design system: record DESIGN.md for new projects, merge conflicting rules into one | Points out the conflicts | ✓ | | From one page to a full set: page map, a reference page per page type, cross-page consistency checks, splitting work across agents | | ✓ | | Revisions: turn "make it feel more premium" into concrete changes, before/after for every round, keep confirmed parts intact, say when the direction itself is wrong | | ✓ | | Polish a single component to the extreme | | ✓ | | 19 card prototypes with code and spatial expansion containers | | ✓ | | Effects such as light trails, dot patterns, and flowing gradients | | ✓ | | Scene layouts, visuals, and state checks for mini-games | | ✓ | | Included free companion `oil-art-landing`: rich desktop & mobile art landing anchors + product-tailored derivation, with foreground-occlusion handoff | | ✓ | Oil UI Pro costs $19.99: a one-time purchase with lifetime updates (+ 100 image generation credits and `oil-art-landing` included free). Get it at [ui.oiloil.org/pro](https://ui.oiloil.org/en/pro/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-en&utm_content=comparison-table-pro), or run `npx github:oil-oil/oil-cli install oil-ui-pro` to let your agent guide sign-in, payment, and installation. ## Version checks Each time it is used, the Skill checks for a newer version at most once every 10 minutes. It only reads the public version list at `ui.oiloil.org` and uploads nothing from your project. By default it only notifies you; nothing is downloaded or replaced unless you explicitly ask to update. Results are cached in `~/.local/state/oil/` (`XDG_STATE_HOME` when set; `%LOCALAPPDATA%\oil\` on Windows). Requires Python 3; set `OIL_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` to disable. ## Use with - [oil-motion](https://github.com/oil-oil/oil-motion): Turn generated videos or frame sequences into web animation controlled by scrolling or dragging, such as product teardowns or camera fly-throughs. - [oil-tone](https://github.com/oil-oil/oil-tone): Rewrites headings, descriptions, and intro copy so they read naturally and clearly in Chinese or English. - [Oil Studio](https://studio.oiloil.org/en/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=oil-ui): Native Apple Silicon Mac screen recorder for capturing auto-zoom product demo videos of your finished UI and cutting voice-overs by editing transcript text. ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
detail.readme_zh:
[English](README.md) · 中文 · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [한국어](https://ui.oiloil.org/ko/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-zh&utm_content=lang-bar) · [Deutsch](https://ui.oiloil.org/de/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-zh&utm_content=lang-bar) · [Español](https://ui.oiloil.org/es/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-zh&utm_content=lang-bar) [![GitHub Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/oil-oil/oil-ui?style=flat-square&color=292e2b)](https://github.com/oil-oil/oil-ui/stargazers) [![skills.sh](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills.sh-4.6K%2B_安装-4a5d4e?style=flat-square)](https://www.skills.sh/oil-oil/oil-ui/oil-ui) [![Live Gallery](https://img.shields.io/badge/在线画廊-141_件真实作品-3d5a45?style=flat-square)](https://ui.oiloil.org/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-zh&utm_content=hero-gallery) [![Blind Benchmark](https://img.shields.io/badge/15次盲测均分-87.0%2F100-5b533b?style=flat-square)](https://ui.oiloil.org/guide/ui-design-skills-tested/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-zh&utm_content=guide-benchmark) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-60675f?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) **Oil UI** 是给 AI 编程 Agent 用的界面与 UI/UX 设计 Skill：默认推荐一个明确的设计方向并对照真实浏览器截图打磨；需要比较时，可并排生成 3 套构图、字体与配色真正拉开差距的方案。网站、App、后台和组件都能做，141 件在线作品见 [ui.oiloil.org](https://ui.oiloil.org/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-zh&utm_content=intro-text)。 ```bash npx skills add oil-oil/oil-ui ``` **兼容宿主：** Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, Cline, Antigravity, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Roo Code, DeepSeek Harness（[dsh-oil-ui](https://github.com/oil-oil/dsh-oil-ui)）, Kimi Code, Trae 及任意支持 `SKILL.md` 的 Agent。

### 把官网做出艺术感（Oil UI Pro 免费附赠 `oil-art-landing`） 除了日常产品界面与后台工作台，**Oil UI Pro** 还免费附赠独立配套 Skill **`oil-art-landing`**：内置**涵盖桌面与移动 App 的丰富视觉锚点**（红外胶片、极地冰川、X 光暗房、温室龟背竹、暗岩苔藓、长虹玻璃、棉纸压凹、陶土沙丘、冰块兰花、靛蓝扎染等）与按业务派生语法，先并排挑方向再按你的产品适配出图，并还原成带前景遮挡层次与滚动动效的真实网页。[查看 20 套可交互实测案例 →](https://ui.oiloil.org/art-landing/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-zh&utm_content=art-landing-banner)

## 安装 在终端直接运行： ```bash npx skills add oil-oil/oil-ui ``` 或者把这句话发给支持安装 Skill 的 Agent： ```text 请帮我安装这个 Skill：运行 npx skills add oil-oil/oil-ui ``` 装好就能用，不需要额外配置。有新版本时，Agent 会在回复末尾提醒你，想更新直接让它更新就行。已经装了 Oil UI Pro 就不用再装开源版，两个同时装会抢着接同一类请求。 如果使用 DeepSeek Harness，可安装原生插件 [dsh-oil-ui](https://github.com/oil-oil/dsh-oil-ui)（`dsh plugin --profile web add github:oil-oil/dsh-oil-ui`，内置免费版，并会自动识别本机已装的 Oil UI Pro）。 ## 使用 直接把任务告诉 Agent，例如： - “用 oil-ui 给这个课程预约产品探索几种设计方向，做成可以预览的页面。” - “做三种字体、配色和构图都不同的设计，放在对比页里让我选。” - “帮我润色这个页面，按项目现有的设计规范来。” - “只评审这个首页，告诉我哪里要改、怎么改，不要动文件。” - “按这张截图还原页面，参考图里没有的手机布局也补上。” 有品牌资料、截图或现成的项目，可以一起交给它。没有参考也能开始，只有在不清楚要交付什么的时候，它才会问你。任务中的候选、截图和素材缓存默认放在项目里的 `.oil-ui` 工作区；正式代码和线上资产仍写回项目。 ## 它怎么设计 1. **先看清这是什么产品。** 动手之前，先明确产品品类，找出同类里风格最鲜明的两三家，看它们怎么做、为什么这么做，再决定哪些沿用、哪些换掉。 2. **把“高级”“简洁”翻成具体的决定。** 先从题材、受众和品牌语气定下调性——热闹还是安静、精致还是粗粝、信息排得密还是疏——再落到字体、留白与色彩占比。 3. **每个方向都从具体的东西出发。** 可以是一种材质和它所在的环境、一个场景，也可以借用另一个领域的表现方式，不从“简约”“大气”这类空泛形容词出发。 4. **先想清楚首屏是给谁看的。** 来看内容、挑东西或干活的页面，首屏直接放内容和操作；需要说服别人的页面，才先定首屏版式再写文案。 5. **明确比较时，几个方向要真的不一样。** 版式、字体、配色和主视觉这四样里，任意两个方向最多只允许一样相同。小样并排眯眼看明暗分布，太像就重排构图，不靠换颜色凑数。 6. **留一处让人记住的地方。** 不把整页塞满装饰，只把一两处关键时刻做到位，比如点按反馈、付款完成、AI 运行状态或 404 页面，其余保持安静。 7. **好不好看由你来定。** 默认推荐一个方向给你确认；明确要求比较时才把几份小样放进同一个对比页，按你的取舍收紧后再往下做。 8. **以真实画面为准。** 做完在桌面和手机尺寸下打开页面看真实截图，可派没有制作上下文的独立评审把关，最后做一轮减法。 想改造存量老项目、合并整理 `DESIGN.md`、按需开启冲 9 分的深度打磨复核，或使用 19 套带源码卡片原型，可以了解 [Oil UI Pro](https://ui.oiloil.org/pro/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-zh&utm_content=inline-pro)，区别见[下文](#开源版和-pro)。 ## 实测横评与实战指南 - **[4 款 UI 设计 Skill 实测对比（15 次独立生成 + 在线 Demo）](https://ui.oiloil.org/guide/ui-design-skills-tested/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-zh&utm_content=guide-benchmark)**：同模型同题测试 Oil UI、`frontend-design`、`UI UX Pro Max`、`Impeccable` 与无 Skill 对照，公开 15 次匿名视觉评分、功能验收细节与真机演示。 - **[已有项目 UI 改造与体验翻新指南](https://ui.oiloil.org/guide/existing-project-ui-renovation/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-zh&utm_content=guide-renovation)**：在不改坏原有接口和校验逻辑的前提下，按「清噪音、调布局、省步骤」分三步翻新老项目，并提炼全站共用的 `DESIGN.md`。 - **[如何去掉 AI 界面的“塑料感”](https://ui.oiloil.org/guide/fix-ai-ui-slop/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-zh&utm_content=guide-antislop)**：逐项拆解胶囊眉标、左侧粗彩条、三层套娃卡片与生造假指标，附可直接放进提示词的减法清单。 - **Agent 与场景实战**：[Claude Code 指南](https://ui.oiloil.org/guide/claude-code-ui-design/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-zh&utm_content=guide-claude) · [OpenAI Codex 指南](https://ui.oiloil.org/guide/codex-ui-design/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-zh&utm_content=guide-codex) · [官网与落地页实战](https://ui.oiloil.org/guide/landing-page-design/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-zh&utm_content=guide-landing) · [后台与桌面工作台实战](https://ui.oiloil.org/guide/dashboard-workspace-design/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-zh&utm_content=guide-dashboard) · [交互式方法与实样展厅](https://ui.oiloil.org/intro/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-zh&utm_content=intro) ## 自带的风格对比页

想比较几份设计时，它会把它们并排放进同一个页面。放进去的可以是 HTML 文件、图片，也可以是正在运行的开发页面，当前版本可放在第一个当对照。支持切换电脑和手机尺寸、点开看实际大小、用方向键翻看；看中哪一份点“选择”，把复制出来的一句话发给 Agent 就能接着推进。 ## 开源版和 Pro

开源版能把一个新页面从头做到好看。Pro 在这之上，帮你把界面做得好用、把老项目稳妥改好，并用更严格的评审和精修把质量往上推。 | | Oil UI 开源版 | Oil UI Pro | | --- | :---: | :---: | | 设计方向：认品类、定调性、拉开方向、风格对比页 | ✓ | ✓ | | 视觉：层级、字体、配色、留白、配图和动效 | ✓ | ✓ | | 让人记住的一刻和滚动叙事（视差、一镜到底） | ✓ | ✓ | | 截图还原 | ✓ | ✓ | | 小游戏的演出节奏、手感、生成素材和实时 3D | ✓ | ✓ | | 独立评审 | 视觉打分与轻量 UX 走查 | 默认盲审 + 可选深度打磨（最多 3 轮冲 9 分与同路径 UX 复核）；检查几个方向有没有撞车；自主风险探针 | | 精修：AI 默认审美自查、细节清单、怎么做减法 | | ✓ | | 好用：交互和状态、表单、弹窗与浮层、电脑和手机上的布局 | | ✓ | | 后台和工具：按产品挑工作区布局，让风格贯穿整页 | | ✓ | | 老项目：优化 UI、改流程、加新功能各有一套做法 | 帮你分清是哪一种 | ✓ | | 把原型实现为工程代码：对照表、用项目已有的组件和库实现、和原型并排核对 | 不整段搬运原型代码 | ✓ | | 设计规范：新项目沉淀 DESIGN.md，多份规范打架时整理成一份 | 指出冲突的地方 | ✓ | | 一页铺成一套：页面地图、各类页面的样板、跨页一致性检查、多个 Agent 分工 | | ✓ | | 回改：把“不够高级”翻成具体改法，每轮附前后对比，不改坏已确认的部分，该重定方向时直说 | | ✓ | | 把单个组件打磨到极致 | | ✓ | | 19 套卡片原型和代码、空间折展容器 | | ✓ | | 流光、点阵、流动渐变这类特效 | | ✓ | | 小游戏的场景布局、视觉和状态检查 | | ✓ | | 免费附赠 `oil-art-landing`：丰富的桌面与移动 App 艺术官网视觉锚点 + 按业务派生，支持前景遮挡落地 | | ✓ | Oil UI Pro 99 元，一次买断，永久更新（送 100 生图积分并免费附赠 `oil-art-landing`），在 [ui.oiloil.org/pro](https://ui.oiloil.org/pro/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme-zh&utm_content=comparison-table-pro) 购买，或运行 `npx github:oil-oil/oil-cli install oil-ui-pro` 由 Agent 带你登录、付款并装好。 ## 版本检查 每次使用时，Skill 最多每 10 分钟联网检查一次是否有新版本。它只读取 `ui.oiloil.org` 公开的版本列表，不上传项目内容；默认只提示，不下载、不替换任何文件，只有你明确要求更新时才更新。检查结果缓存在 `~/.local/state/oil/`（设置了 `XDG_STATE_HOME` 时用它，Windows 在 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\oil\`）。需要 Python 3；不想检查时设置环境变量 `OIL_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1`。 ## 搭配使用 - [oil-motion](https://github.com/oil-oil/oil-motion)：用生成的视频或序列帧做随滚动、拖动变化的网页动画，比如产品拆解、镜头穿越。 - [oil-tone](https://github.com/oil-oil/oil-tone)：把页面上的标题、说明和介绍改得自然、清楚、好读，中英文都能用。 - [Oil Studio](https://studio.oiloil.org/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme-zh&utm_campaign=oil-ui)：Apple Silicon Mac 原生自动缩放录屏工具，做完界面后直接录制高质感产品演示视频，并支持离线 Whisper 按字剪画面。 - [Oil Book 相关文章](https://book.oiloil.org/articles/ai-ui-design?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=oil-ui-readme-zh)：想看平时怎么挑高审美模型、做多方向对比和微调界面细节，可以参考《如何使用 AI 做出有高级感的设计》和[《如何从 0 到 1 Vibe Coding 一个个人网站》](https://book.oiloil.org/articles/vibe-coding-website-from-scratch?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=oil-ui-readme-zh)。 ## 许可 [MIT](LICENSE)
